_note: Chapter 19 词汇卡内容。ipa = 音标; ex = 例句数组, 顺序与词表中该词出现的行序一致(多词性词给多个例句, 每个例句对应词性行); note = 用法提示/搭配。

ex.en: Passengers felt the train accelerate as it left the station.
ex.cn: 火车驶出车站时，乘客感到列车加速了。
ex.note: accelerate the growth 加快增长；accelerator 加速器

ex.en: He acquired the habit of running within a month.
ex.cn: 不到一个月，他就养成了跑步的习惯。
ex.note: acquire a habit 养成习惯；acquire a skill 掌握一项技能

ex.en: Being able to train early in the morning was a real advantage.
ex.cn: 能一大早起来训练是一项真正的优势。
ex.note: take advantage of 利用；have an advantage over 胜过

ex.en: The aim of the plan is to walk ten thousand steps a day.
ex.cn: 这份计划的目标是每天走一万步。
ex.note: with the aim of 旨在；achieve one's aim 实现目标

ex.en: The charity aims to raise money for rural schools.
ex.cn: 这项慈善活动旨在为乡村学校筹款。
ex.note: aim at 瞄准；旨在

ex.en: Her quick recovery after the operation amazed the doctors.
ex.cn: 她术后恢复之快让医生们大为惊奇。
ex.note: be amazed at 对……感到惊奇；amazing 令人惊叹的

ex.en: Nobody in the room knew the answer to her question.
ex.cn: 屋里没人知道她问题的答案。
ex.note: the answer to 对……的回答；answer key 答案

ex.en: He answered the phone in a sleepy voice.
ex.cn: 他睡意朦胧地接起了电话。
ex.note: answer the phone 接电话；answer for 对……负责

ex.en: The club appointed him as the captain of the team.
ex.cn: 俱乐部任命他为球队队长。
ex.note: appoint sb. as 任命某人为；appoint sb. to 任命某人担任

ex.en: The school built an artificial lake for the students to run around.
ex.cn: 学校造了一个人工湖，供学生们绕着跑步。
ex.note: artificial light 人造光；an artificial smile 假笑

ex.en: He did not have an atom of common sense.
ex.cn: 他连一丁点常识都没有。
ex.note: an atom of 一点点；atomic energy 原子能

ex.en: The winner received a small golden medal as an award.
ex.cn: 获胜者得到一枚小小的金牌作为奖励。
ex.note: win/receive an award 获奖

ex.en: The judges awarded the first prize to a student from the north.
ex.cn: 评委把一等奖颁给了一位来自北方的学生。
ex.note: award sb. sth. 把某物授予某人

ex.en: He ran along the beach with bare feet.
ex.cn: 他赤着脚沿着沙滩跑。
ex.note: bare hands 空手；the bare truth 赤裸裸的事实

ex.en: She finally beat her old record by ten seconds.
ex.cn: 她最后把自己的旧纪录提高了十秒。
ex.note: beat sb. 打败某人；beat the record 打破纪录

ex.en: The music has a slow, steady beat that is easy to run to.
ex.cn: 这段音乐有一个缓慢而稳定的节拍，很适合跟着跑。
ex.note: heart beat 心跳；at heart pace 拼命地

ex.en: Regular walking is beneficial to both body and mind.
ex.cn: 经常散步对身心都有好处。
ex.note: be beneficial to 对……有益

ex.en: He filled in the blank form with his name and address.
ex.cn: 他把姓名和地址填在了空白表格上。
ex.note: a blank form 空白表格；a blank stare 茫然的眼神

ex.en: Leave the last two lines of the form blank.
ex.cn: 表格的最后两行留空。
ex.note: fill in the blanks 填空；blank space 空白处

ex.en: They walked to the border of the forest before turning back.
ex.cn: 他们走到森林的边缘才折返回来。
ex.note: on the border of 在……边界上；border area 边境地区

ex.en: The river borders the small town on three sides.
ex.cn: 这条河三面环绕着这座小镇。
ex.note: border on 与……接壤；border upon 与……相邻

ex.en: A cool breeze came in through the open window.
ex.cn: 一阵凉风从开着的窗户吹了进来。
ex.note: a breeze 轻而易举的事；light breeze 微风

ex.en: We took the bus downtown to save money.
ex.cn: 我们坐公交去市中心，好省些钱。
ex.note: on the bus 在公交车上；bus stop 公交车站

ex.en: You can start with one small habit.
ex.cn: 你可以从一个小习惯开始。
ex.note: can 表示能力或许可；cannot 表否定

ex.en: He opened a can of soup and ate it with bread.
ex.cn: 他打开一罐汤，就着面包吃了。
ex.note: a can of 一罐；tin can 罐头

ex.en: Her case was quite different: she had trained for years.
ex.cn: 她的情况很不一样：她已经训练多年。
ex.note: in that case 在那种情况下；a medical case 病例

ex.en: I will certainly come if you need any help.
ex.cn: 你需要帮忙的话我一定来。
ex.note: certainly not  certainly 用于否定时表示强调

ex.en: You can buy that medicine at any chemist on the high street.
ex.cn: 商业街上随便哪家药店都能买到那种药。
ex.note: chemist's 药店；a research chemist 研究化学家

ex.en: Under the circumstances, a short walk was better than nothing.
ex.cn: 在这种情况下，散一会儿步总比什么都不做强。
ex.note: under no circumstances 决不；under the circumstances 在这种情况下

ex.en: Close the window, or the cold will get in.
ex.cn: 把窗户关上，不然冷气会灌进来。
ex.note: close the door 关门；close down 关闭（工厂等）

ex.en: The exam is close, so she studies every evening.
ex.cn: 考试快到了，所以她每天晚上都用功。
ex.note: close to 接近；a close friend 密友

ex.en: He picked up a comb and brushed his hair in front of the mirror.
ex.cn: 他拿起梳子，对着镜子梳头发。
ex.note: a hair comb 一把梳子

ex.en: The police combed the whole forest looking for the missing boy.
ex.cn: 警方搜遍了整片森林，寻找那个失踪的男孩。
ex.note: comb through 仔细搜查

ex.en: Nothing could compel him to leave his bed that morning.
ex.cn: 那天早上，什么也催不起他起床。
ex.note: compel sb. to do 强迫某人做

ex.en: The doctor concluded that he needed more exercise.
ex.cn: 医生断定他需要更多的锻炼。
ex.note: conclude that … 断定；conclude a speech 结束演讲

ex.en: The money raised by the run goes to wildlife conservation.
ex.cn: 这次跑步筹得的钱将用于野生动物保护。
ex.note: wildlife conservation 野生动物保护；energy conservation 节能

ex.en: Contrary to popular belief, drinking water does not help you lose weight.
ex.cn: 与普遍的看法相反，喝水并不能帮你减肥。
ex.note: contrary to 与……相反

ex.en: The evidence was weak; on the contrary, it proved him innocent.
ex.cn: 证据并不有力；恰恰相反，它证明了他的清白。
ex.note: to the contrary 相反地；on the contrary 恰恰相反

ex.en: Each level of the course corresponds to a different skill.
ex.cn: 这门课程的每一个级别都对应一种不同的能力。
ex.note: correspond to 相当于；correspond with 与……相符

ex.en: Running well is a craft that takes years to learn.
ex.cn: 跑得好是一门要练上多年才学得会的手艺。
ex.note: by craft 凭手艺；arts and crafts 手工艺

ex.en: She began to cry when she saw the old photograph.
ex.cn: 看到那张旧照片时，她哭了起来。
ex.note: cry for joy 喜极而泣；cry out 喊叫

ex.en: They danced until the music finally stopped.
ex.cn: 他们一直跳到音乐停下为止。
ex.note: dance with 和……一起跳舞；a square dance 方块舞

ex.en: Prices are given to two decimal places on the receipt.
ex.cn: 收据上的价格保留两位小数。
ex.note: decimal point 小数点；decimal system 十进制

ex.en: The result was expressed as a decimal, not a fraction.
ex.cn: 结果是用小数而不是分数表示的。
ex.note: a repeating decimal 循环小数

ex.en: A good diet should meet the body's demand for energy.
ex.cn: 好的饮食应当满足身体对能量的需求。
ex.note: demand that … 要求；a heavy demand 大量需求

ex.en: The destination of the walk was a small hill outside the town.
ex.cn: 这次步行的目的地是城外的一座小山。
ex.note: reach one's destination 到达目的地

ex.en: Everyone in the class comes from a different town.
ex.cn: 班上每个人都来自不同的小镇。
ex.note: be different from 与……不同；differ from 不同于

ex.en: The heavy rain discouraged them from going out to train.
ex.cn: 大雨让他们打消了外出训练的主意。
ex.note: discourage sb. from doing 劝阻某人做

ex.en: The shop sells food from a diverse range of countries.
ex.cn: 这家店出售来自各个国家的食品。
ex.note: a diverse range of 多种多样的

ex.en: We took the bus downtown and had lunch there.
ex.cn: 我们坐公交到了市中心，在那儿吃了午饭。
ex.note: go downtown 去市中心；downtown area 市中心区域

ex.en: It was a dumb mistake, and he knew it at once.
ex.cn: 那是个愚蠢的错误，他立刻就意识到了。
ex.note: dumb luck 瞎猫撞死老鼠；play dumb 装傻

ex.en: A young economist at the university gave a short talk on inflation.
ex.cn: 大学里一位年轻的经济学家做了一个关于通货膨胀的简短讲座。
ex.note: economist 经济学家

ex.en: She moved across the floor with an elegant rhythm.
ex.cn: 她以一种优雅的节奏走过场地。
ex.note: an elegant solution 巧妙的办法；elegant design 雅致的设计

ex.en: We encountered several problems while building the new system.
ex.cn: 我们搭建新系统时遇到了几个问题。
ex.note: encounter difficulties 遇到困难

ex.en: Their encounter with the steep hill was harder than they had expected.
ex.cn: 他们与那座陡坡的相遇比预想的要艰难。
ex.note: a chance encounter 偶遇

ex.en: Plastic bottles are bad for the environment.
ex.cn: 塑料瓶对环境有害。
ex.note: protect the environment 保护环境

ex.en: Everyone in the room turned to look at the new student.
ex.cn: 房间里的每个人都转头看着这个新学生。
ex.note: everyone else 其他人

ex.en: Regular exercise has done him a great deal of good.
ex.cn: 经常锻炼让他受益良多。
ex.note: take exercise 锻炼；do exercises 做练习

ex.en: You should exercise at least three times a week.
ex.cn: 你至少每周应该锻炼三次。
ex.note: exercise oneself 锻炼身体

ex.en: The coach made them run an extra lap before the session ended.
ex.cn: 训练结束前，教练让他们多跑了一圈。
ex.note: extra time 加时；extraordinary 非同寻常的

ex.en: The hotel charged extra for late check-out.
ex.cn: 酒店为延迟退房额外收费。
ex.note: a bit extra 多一点；extra help 额外的帮助

ex.en: I fancy a cup of tea after the run.
ex.cn: 跑完步我想来一杯茶。
ex.note: fancy doing 想要做；fancy that … 认为

ex.en: She wore a fancy dress to the graduation ceremony.
ex.cn: 她穿着一件华丽的礼服去参加毕业典礼。
ex.note: fancy dress 化装舞会；a fancy price 高价

ex.en: Children have a natural fancy for bright colours.
ex.cn: 孩子天生喜爱明亮的颜色。
ex.note: a fancy for 喜爱；take a fancy to 喜欢上

ex.en: The new term begins in February this year.
ex.cn: 新学期今年二月开始。
ex.note: in February 在二月

ex.en: After three months of training, he finally ran the whole distance.
ex.cn: 训练了三个月之后，他终于跑完了全程。
ex.note: at last 最后；finally 终于

ex.en: Her office is on the third floor of the teaching building.
ex.cn: 她的办公室在教学楼三层。
ex.note: on the ground floor 在一层；the floor 地板

ex.en: They ran along a path that led into the forest.
ex.cn: 他们沿着一条通向森林的小路跑去。
ex.note: forest fire 森林大火；a forest of … 密密麻麻的……

ex.en: His hands began to freeze in the cold wind.
ex.cn: 在寒风里，他的手开始冻僵。
ex.note: freeze to death 冻死；freeze over 结冰

ex.en: The old furniture in the waiting room had seen better days.
ex.cn: 候诊室里的旧家具曾经也有过好日子。
ex.note: a piece of furniture 一件家具

ex.en: She spoke in a gentle voice to the frightened child.
ex.cn: 她用温柔的声音对那个受惊的孩子说话。
ex.note: a gentle breeze 微风；a gentle reminder 温和的提醒

ex.en: She won a golden medal at the school games.
ex.cn: 她在校运会上赢得一枚金牌。
ex.note: the golden age 黄金时代；a golden opportunity 难得的机会

ex.en: He was grateful for the hot meal after the long climb.
ex.cn: 长距离爬坡之后，那顿热饭让他心存感激。
ex.note: be grateful for/to 对……心怀感激

ex.en: The gulf between the rich and the poor widened over the years.
ex.cn: 富人与穷人之间的鸿沟这些年来越拉越大。
ex.note: a gulf between … ……之间的鸿沟

ex.en: Smoking is harmful to your lungs and your heart.
ex.cn: 吸烟对肺和心脏都有害。
ex.note: be harmful to 对……有害

ex.en: The nurse measured his height and weight.
ex.cn: 护士量了他的身高和体重。
ex.note: at the height of 在……的高峰；the height of fashion 时髦

ex.en: He did not tell his parents about the results.
ex.cn: 他没有把检查结果告诉父母。
ex.note: his and hers 他们的和她的

ex.en: Their host family made them feel at home from the first day.
ex.cn: 接待他们的那家人从第一天起就让他们觉得像在自己家里。
ex.note: host family 接待家庭；host country 主办国

ex.en: The club will host the meeting in its new hall.
ex.cn: 俱乐部将在新的大厅里举办这次聚会。
ex.note: host an event 举办活动

ex.en: I have no idea what she meant by that.
ex.cn: 我完全不明白她那句话是什么意思。
ex.note: a good idea 好主意；the idea of … 的想法

ex.en: She did not say it directly, but her tone implied a warning.
ex.cn: 她没有明说，但她的语气里带着警告。
ex.note: imply that … 暗示；it is implied 不言而喻

ex.en: The indoor swimming pool opens at six every morning.
ex.cn: 室内游泳池每天早上六点开门。
ex.note: indoor sports 室内运动；an indoor hall 室内馆

ex.en: An inquiry has been opened into the cause of the fire.
ex.cn: 当局已对火灾的起因展开调查。
ex.note: make an inquiry into 调查；answer an inquiry 回答询问

ex.en: She pays interest on the money she has saved.
ex.cn: 她为存下的钱支付利息。
ex.note: interest rate 利率；take an interest in 对……感兴趣

ex.en: The story interested me from the very first page.
ex.cn: 这个故事从第一页起就吸引住了我。
ex.note: interest sb. in sth. 使某人对某事感兴趣

ex.en: The magazine publishes an issue every month.
ex.cn: 这本杂志每月出版一期。
ex.note: raise an issue 提出议题；the latest issue 最新一期

ex.en: The government issued a warning about the coming storm.
ex.cn: 政府就即将到来的风暴发布了警告。
ex.note: issue a statement 发表声明

ex.en: Her heart jumped when the phone rang in the middle of the night.
ex.cn: 半夜电话响起时，她的心跳漏了一拍。
ex.note: jump to conclusions 妄下结论；jump up 跳起来

ex.en: Someone knocked at the door and she went to open it.
ex.cn: 有人敲门，她走过去把门打开了。
ex.note: knock at/on 敲；knock down 撞倒

ex.en: The room was filled with laughter and applause.
ex.cn: 房间里充满了笑声和掌声。
ex.note: burst into laughter 放声大笑

ex.en: An old legend says that the lake is home to a dragon.
ex.cn: 一个古老的传说说，那座湖里住着一条龙。
ex.note: a legend in his own lifetime 活着的传奇

ex.en: One limitation of the method is that it takes a lot of time.
ex.cn: 这个方法的一个局限是它很费时间。
ex.note: have limitations 有局限；beyond the limitation 超出限制

ex.en: She felt lonely in the big city during her first year.
ex.cn: 第一年，她在这座大城市里感到孤单。
ex.note: a lonely road 孤独的路；feel lonely 感到孤独

ex.en: She reads a magazine while waiting for the bus.
ex.cn: 等公交的时候她读杂志。
ex.note: a fashion magazine 时尚杂志

ex.en: She wrote a short note in the margin of the page.
ex.cn: 她在书页的页边空白处写下一行小字。
ex.note: in the margin 在页边；profit margin 利润率

ex.en: Take a careful measurement of the room before you buy the desk.
ex.cn: 买书桌之前先仔细量一下房间的尺寸。
ex.note: take a measurement 测量；measurement unit 计量单位

ex.en: The scientist looked at the sample through a microscope.
ex.cn: 科学家用显微镜观察那个样本。
ex.note: under the microscope 在显微镜下

ex.en: It was a mistake to leave the medicine on the table.
ex.cn: 把药放在桌上是个错误。
ex.note: make a mistake 犯错；by mistake 错误地

ex.en: Do not mistake silence for agreement.
ex.cn: 别把沉默误当成同意。
ex.note: mistake A for B 把 A 误认为 B

ex.en: Every mother in the queue was holding a child's hand.
ex.cn: 排队里的每位母亲都牵着一个孩子的手。
ex.note: mother tongue 母语；like the mother like the daughter 有其母必有其女

ex.en: His sudden success remained a mystery to his friends.
ex.cn: 他突然的成功在朋友看来仍是个谜。
ex.note: an unsolved mystery 未解之谜；be a mystery to sb. 对某人是个谜

ex.en: A neighbor from my building told me about the free clinic.
ex.cn: 我楼里的一个邻居告诉我有个免费诊所。
ex.note: next-door neighbor 隔壁邻居；neighboring country 邻国

ex.en: The street outside the clinic was noisy at noon.
ex.cn: 诊所外的街道到了中午很吵。
ex.note: a noisy neighbour 吵闹的邻居

ex.en: She keeps a bag of mixed nuts in her desk.
ex.cn: 她在办公桌里放着一袋混合坚果。
ex.note: a bunch of nuts 一堆坚果；nutty about 对……着迷

ex.en: Police officers had closed the road to all traffic.
ex.cn: 警察已经封了路，禁止一切车辆通行。
ex.note: a police officer 一名警察；officer 军官

ex.en: Would you like tea or coffee after the run?
ex.cn: 跑完步你想喝茶还是咖啡？
ex.note: either … or … 或者……或者……

ex.en: It was too cold outside, so they ran indoors instead.
ex.cn: 外面太冷了，所以他们改在室内跑。
ex.note: outside of 在……之外；come outside 出来

ex.en: These gloves come in three sizes; she chose the largest pair.
ex.cn: 这副手套有三种尺码，她挑了最大的一双。
ex.note: a pair of 一双、一对

ex.en: The teacher paired each student with a partner for the exercise.
ex.cn: 老师给每个学生配了一个搭档来做练习。
ex.note: pair A with B 把 A 和 B 配成一对

ex.en: Her passion for teaching kept her going through the hard years.
ex.cn: 对教学的热情让她熬过了那些艰难的年头。
ex.note: a passion for 对……的热情；with passion 热情地

ex.en: He lives on a small pension after his retirement.
ex.cn: 退休以后，他靠一小笔养老金过活。
ex.note: on a pension 靠养老金生活；retirement pension 退休金

ex.en: A retired philosopher wrote the book that changed his life.
ex.cn: 一位退休的哲学家写下了改变他一生的那本书。
ex.note: a natural philosopher 哲学家

ex.en: She found a quiet place to study near the library.
ex.cn: 她在图书馆附近找了个安静的看书的地方。
ex.note: take place 发生；a place of … ……的地方

ex.en: The waiter placed a cup of tea on the table.
ex.cn: 服务员把一杯茶放在桌上。
ex.note: place an order 下订单

ex.en: He called the police after the shop was broken into.
ex.cn: 店铺被撬之后，他报了警。
ex.note: call the police 报警；the police 警方

ex.en: There is a real possibility of rain this afternoon.
ex.cn: 今天下午真的有可能下雨。
ex.note: the possibility of … 的可能性；open up possibilities 打开可能性

ex.en: Education should be free from prejudice of any kind.
ex.cn: 教育应当不带任何形式的偏见。
ex.note: a prejudice against 对……的偏见；prejudice sb. against 使某人对……有偏见

ex.en: The old warehouse was like a prison, cold and dark.
ex.cn: 那座旧仓库像一座监狱，又冷又暗。
ex.note: go to prison 进监狱；prison cell 牢房

ex.en: A little practice every day will improve your pronunciation.
ex.cn: 每天练上一点，你的发音就会好起来。
ex.note: have a good pronunciation 发音标准

ex.en: Please be punctual; the meeting starts at nine sharp.
ex.cn: 请准时到会，会议九点整开始。
ex.note: punctual for 对……守时；punctuality 守时

ex.en: The law forbids racial discrimination in employment.
ex.cn: 法律禁止就业中的种族歧视。
ex.note: racial discrimination 种族歧视；racial prejudice 种族偏见

ex.en: The nurse took his blood pressure reading and wrote it down.
ex.cn: 护士量了他的血压读数，把它记了下来。
ex.note: a reading of 读数；reading comprehension 阅读理解

ex.en: Walking to work can reduce your monthly transport costs.
ex.cn: 步行上班能减少你每月的交通开支。
ex.note: reduce sth. by 减少……；reduce to 减少到

ex.en: The company released the new version of the app on Friday.
ex.cn: 公司周五发布了这款应用的新版本。
ex.note: release pressure 释放压力；release a film 发行电影

ex.en: The release of the film was delayed by two weeks.
ex.cn: 这部电影的发行推迟了两周。
ex.note: the latest release 最新发行版；on release 发行时

ex.en: The republic celebrated its seventieth anniversary in October.
ex.cn: 十月，这个共和国庆祝了成立七十周年。
ex.note: the People's Republic 中华人民共和国

ex.en: The result of the test came back within a week.
ex.cn: 检查结果一周后就出来了。
ex.note: as a result 结果；a direct result 直接结果

ex.en: Months of patient training resulted in a much better time.
ex.cn: 耐心训练了几个月，成绩好了许多。
ex.note: result in 导致；result from 起因于

ex.en: The charity run follows the river for ten kilometers.
ex.cn: 这场慈善跑沿着河跑十公里。
ex.note: up the river 逆流而上；a river of 一股……的洪流

ex.en: A single heavy storm can ruin the whole harvest.
ex.cn: 一场大风暴就足以毁掉整年的收成。
ex.note: ruin one's life 毁掉一生；be ruined 毁了

ex.en: The old castle was left in ruins after the fire.
ex.cn: 那座老城堡在大火之后成了废墟。
ex.note: in ruins 成了废墟；a ruined reputation 毁了的名声

ex.en: Nothing on the menu satisfied his hunger.
ex.cn: 菜单上没有任何东西能满足他的饥饿。
ex.note: satisfy sb. of sth. 使某人对某事满意；be satisfied with 满意于

ex.en: There is plenty of scope for improvement in the second half.
ex.cn: 下半场还有很大的改进余地。
ex.note: have scope for 有……的余地；beyond the scope of 超出……范围

ex.en: He realized that his best self was still ahead of him.
ex.cn: 他意识到，自己最好的状态还在前面。
ex.note: one's true self 真我；self-confidence 自信

ex.en: The survey records the age and sex of every student.
ex.cn: 这份调查记录每个学生的年龄和性别。
ex.note: of both sexes 男女两性的

ex.en: Everyone has shortcomings; the key is to learn from them.
ex.cn: 人人都有缺点，关键是从中汲取教训。
ex.note: overcome one's shortcomings 克服缺点

ex.en: It is simply not possible to learn a language in a week.
ex.cn: 一周之内学好一门语言，这根本不可能。
ex.note: simply because 只是因为；simply not 根本不可能

ex.en: He pulled his sleeve over his hand to keep it warm.
ex.cn: 他把袖口拉过手背，好让它暖和些。
ex.note: a shirt sleeve 衬衫袖子；rolled-up sleeves 卷起的袖子

ex.en: He gave up soda and drank plain water instead.
ex.cn: 他戒掉了汽水，改喝白水。
ex.note: soda water 苏打水

ex.en: For lunch they bought bread, cheese and a bowl of soup.
ex.cn: 午饭他们买了面包、奶酪和一碗汤。
ex.note: a bowl of soup 一碗汤；hot soup 热汤

ex.en: A small spider sat quietly in the corner of the window.
ex.cn: 一只小蜘蛛安静地蹲在窗户的角落里。
ex.note: spider web 蜘蛛网

ex.en: Stand near the finish line and cheer the runners on.
ex.cn: 站在终点线附近，为跑者加油鼓劲。
ex.note: stand for 代表；stand up to 勇敢面对

ex.en: A wooden stand at the entrance held the notices of the event.
ex.cn: 入口处的木架子上贴着这次活动的通知。
ex.note: a book stand 书架；take one's stand 表明立场

ex.en: She stirred the soup slowly and added a pinch of salt.
ex.cn: 她慢慢搅动着汤，加了一小撮盐。
ex.note: stir up 激起；stir one's memories 唤起回忆

ex.en: His words caused quite a stir among the students.
ex.cn: 他的话在学生中引起了不小的骚动。
ex.note: cause a stir 引起轰动

ex.en: She tied the parcel with a piece of string.
ex.cn: 她用一根细绳把包裹扎好。
ex.note: a string of 一串；string instrument 弦乐器

ex.en: He drinks his coffee with no sugar at all.
ex.cn: 他喝咖啡一点糖也不加。
ex.note: sugar cube 方糖；without sugar 不加糖

ex.en: The surface of the old table was covered with dust.
ex.cn: 那张旧桌子的表面蒙着一层灰。
ex.note: on the surface 表面上；surface area 表面积

ex.en: The truth about the accident finally surfaced last week.
ex.cn: 关于那场事故的真相上周终于浮出水面。
ex.note: surface a problem 暴露问题

ex.en: The school has a simple system for reporting absences.
ex.cn: 学校有一套简单的请假报告制度。
ex.note: a system of 系统；in the system 在系统内

ex.en: Copying the figures by hand was tedious but necessary.
ex.cn: 手抄那些数字枯燥却必要。
ex.note: tedious task 枯燥的任务；tedious work 单调乏味的工作

ex.en: "That is not what I meant," he said quietly.
ex.cn: “那不是我的意思。”他轻声说。
ex.note: that is 那就是；in those days 从前

ex.en: He ran so fast that he could not hear the crowd.
ex.cn: 他跑得太快，连人群的喊声都听不见了。
ex.note: so … that … 如此……以至于……；because 因为

ex.en: This is the plan that we agreed on last week.
ex.cn: 这就是我们上周商定的计划。
ex.note: like this 像这样；this way 这样

ex.en: The bus timetable had been changed for the summer.
ex.cn: 暑期的公交时刻表改了。
ex.note: a train timetable 火车时刻表；on a tight timetable 时间安排得很紧

ex.en: The total cost of the trip was lower than they had expected.
ex.cn: 这次旅行的总花费低于他们的预期。
ex.note: the total number of 总数；total amount 总金额

ex.en: Add up the figures and write the total at the bottom.
ex.cn: 把这些数字加起来，把总数写在下面。
ex.note: in total 总共；a total of 总共

ex.en: The three laps totalled more than ten kilometers.
ex.cn: 这三圈加起来超过十公里。
ex.note: total (up) 合计

ex.en: Please take your trash to the bin at the back.
ex.cn: 请把垃圾带到后面的垃圾桶去。
ex.note: trash can 垃圾桶；throw away trash 扔掉垃圾

ex.en: She kept trying to talk to the doctor through the noise.
ex.cn: 她一直试着在嘈杂声中跟医生说话。
ex.note: try to do 努力做；try doing 试着做

ex.en: It is worth a try, even if you fail the first time.
ex.cn: 哪怕第一次失败，这也值得一试。
ex.note: have a try 试一试；a first try 初次尝试

ex.en: It took him a whole year to understand why she had left.
ex.cn: 他花了整整一年才明白她为什么离开。
ex.note: I understand 我明白了；It is difficult to understand … 很难理解……

ex.en: The route ran through the busy urban streets of the city.
ex.cn: 路线穿过城市繁忙的市区街道。
ex.note: urban life 城市生活；urban areas 市区

ex.en: Prices vary from shop to shop along this street.
ex.cn: 这条街上各家店的价格都不一样。
ex.note: vary from … to … 从……到……不等；it varies 视情况而定

ex.en: You need a visa before you can start work there.
ex.cn: 你得先拿到签证，才能去那里工作。
ex.note: apply for a visa 申请签证；visa-free 免签的

ex.en: The hospital has a new children's ward on the third floor.
ex.cn: 医院在三楼新设了一间儿科病房。
ex.note: be in the ward 住院；ward nurse 病房护士

ex.en: A weekly plan is easier to follow than a daily one.
ex.cn: 每周的计划比每天的计划更容易坚持。
ex.note: weekly meeting 周会；twice weekly 每周两次

ex.en: I bought a weekly at the station and read it on the train.
ex.cn: 我在车站买了一份周刊，在火车上读。
ex.note: a news weekly 新闻周刊；the weekly 本刊

ex.en: Whoever leaves the room last should turn off the lights.
ex.cn: 谁最后离开房间，谁就负责关灯。
ex.note: no matter who 无论谁；whoever it is 不管是谁

ex.en: The old bridge was crossed without a single guard rail.
ex.cn: 那座老桥连一道护栏都没有。
ex.note: without doing 不做；without help 未经帮助

ex.en: Write your answers in ink, not in pencil.
ex.cn: 用钢笔答题，不要用铅笔。
ex.note: write sth. for sb. 为某人写；write to sb. 给某人写信
